definitions.explanation: Nitrogen in its liquid state, kept at extremely low temperatures (around −196°C). Used in science, medicine, food processing, and industrial applications for rapid freezing and cooling.

examples.japanese: {液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{瞬間的|しゅんかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{凍|こお}らせた→凍る：02100_kooru⟧。
examples.english: It was frozen instantly with liquid nitrogen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Gloves are necessary when using liquid nitrogen in experiments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{凍結療法|とうけつりょうほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、いぼやほくろ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除去|じょきょ}する→除去する：22368_jokyosuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In dermatology, warts and moles are sometimes removed using cryotherapy with liquid nitrogen.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧ (liquid) and ⟦{窒素|ちっそ}→窒素：11106_chisso⟧ (nitrogen). Often abbreviated to {液窒|えきちつ} in informal or technical shorthand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{凍|こお}らせる→凍る：02100_kooru⟧: to freeze with liquid nitrogen
- {液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour liquid nitrogen
- {液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧: liquid nitrogen container (Dewar flask)
- {液体窒素|えきたいちっそ}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: preservation in liquid nitrogen

USAGE:
In everyday contexts, Japanese people most commonly encounter {液体窒素|えきたいちっそ} in dermatology clinics (for wart removal) and in science demonstration videos or TV shows. It has also become popular in trendy dessert shops that use it to make instant ice cream.
